title: Task Frame
description: PARSE-stage output: the structured, declarative plan for ONE task (mode + entry-stage + agent subset + gate level + budget). Domain-agnostic. This is the lightweight 'plan' the orchestrator emits; it is NOT a free-form planning doc.

project.description: The research project (lowercase-kebab slug, registered in the vault's 05-registry/project-registry.md) this run belongs to. Groups the run under runs/<project>/<run_id>/. null = legacy flat layout (pre-project runs / isolated tests).

mode.description: Routing mode, e.g. check_run, design_experiment, evidence_review, gap_scan

north_star.description: The run's immutable direction contract (audit H2 fix). Pinned at PARSE, hashed into the ledger (task_frame_pinned event), injected into every worker prompt, and enforced per stage by tools/drift_gate.py. Only the director re-scopes a run.

statement.description: One sentence: the ONLY direction of this run (defaults to request_text when the director gives no separate statement)

in_scope.description: Topics/terms explicitly inside the direction (extra drift-gate anchor vocabulary)

out_of_scope.description: Topics explicitly excluded — their appearance in any stage output is a hard drift violation

entry_stage.description: Where this task enters the spine; upstream stages may be skipped (recorded), gated stages may not

stage_path.description: Optional explicit forward-only subset of stages this mode drives, starting at entry_stage and ending at REPORT. When absent, the engine drives every stage from entry_stage to REPORT (default full tail). Lets a mode express its true shape, e.g. evidence_review = [DISCOVER, REPORT] (forward-skip of experiment stages). Gated stages are never silently dropped — a director_signoff task must keep its entry stage's hard gates (router enforces).

agent_subset.description: Which agents this task activates (the WORK slot). Even a tiny task names >=1 worker.

gate_level.description: How hard the REVIEW gate is: auto (low-risk reversible), record_only (audit line), director_signoff (irreversible / truth-claim)

model_policy.description: Model-allocation mode for this run. default = task-appropriate per-agent (opus for judgment/hard-gates/sign-off, sonnet for execution; haiku never used). max_quality = every reasoning agent forced to opus (director opt-in). model:none deterministic agents are unaffected by either mode.

domain_profile_ref.description: Active domain profile id (profiles/*.yaml); null for domain-neutral tasks

budget.description: Stopping conditions; prevents unbounded research sprawl (budget-and-stop-controller)
